Initial release — create and export videos online from your images or clips, no editing software needed.

- Upload product photos and a logo to generate 1080p videos in 30–60 seconds.
- Simple prompts handle video creation, export, credits check, and timeline previews.
- Automatic cloud session setup—free 7-day credits if no token provided.
- All processing happens on cloud GPUs; just drop files and describe what you want.
- Supports export in multiple formats (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG, etc.).
- Clear error handling, no technical steps exposed to users.
